# Test fixtures

Small inputs the tests read. Nothing here is generated at test time.

| Path | What it is | Source and terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `structures/1L2Y.cif` | Trp-cage miniprotein, NMR | wwPDB entry 1L2Y, CC0 |
| `structures/1A3N.cif` | human deoxyhemoglobin | wwPDB entry 1A3N, CC0 |
| `structures/181L.cif` | T4 lysozyme L99A with benzene | wwPDB entry 181L, CC0 |
| `structures/1P7E.cif` | protein structure used by the stability-change tests | wwPDB entry 1P7E, CC0 |
| `hemoglobin/P69905.json`, `hemoglobin-alpha.fasta` | UniProtKB record and sequence of human hemoglobin alpha | UniProt, CC BY 4.0 |
| `constructs/puc19.gb` | cloning vector pUC19, GenBank M77789 | INSDC record |
| `enzyme-reaction-panel/` | a sequence-selected projection of the SrIRED lrDMS v2.0.0 dataset with its accounting | Gantz and colleagues, CC BY 4.0; see `source-accounting.json` |
| `reactions/chorismate/` | chorismate reaction with its ChEBI species | Rhea reaction 13897, CC BY 4.0; see `manifest.json` |
| `variant-benchmark/bslipa-t50-observations.csv` | Lipase A T50 measurements of 2,172 variants, read by the variant benchmark | ProteinGym 1.3, ESTA_BACSU_Nutschel_2020, MIT dataset declaration; Nutschel and colleagues, doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00954 |
| `operation/` | small operating-model records written for the tests | synthetic |
